security_audit.summary: The skill is a legitimate deployment troubleshooting guide, but it directs agents to run cloud CLI commands and inspect environment configuration. Several static findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, while secret handling, .env.local access, log retrieval, build execution, and package installation guidance remain real risks.

remediation.issue: The skill asks agents to inspect local and hosted environment settings that may contain secrets.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user authorization before reading environment files or provider settings, and report only variable names and mismatch status.

remediation.issue: Deployment log checks can expose operational data, tokens, stack traces, or user information.
remediation.suggestion: Add instructions to redact secrets, user data, and internal hostnames before saving or sharing audit output.

remediation.issue: The troubleshooting section recommends installing an arbitrary missing module.
remediation.suggestion: Require package review, version pinning, and user confirmation before installing any dependency.

remediation.issue: The skill includes external command guidance for cloud and build tooling.
remediation.suggestion: Document read-only command boundaries and require confirmation before running commands that modify files, dependencies, or deployment state.

content.user_title: Audit Deployment Health and Runtime Issues
content.value_statement: Deployment failures are hard to diagnose when logs, settings, and build output are split across platforms. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused checks for deployment readiness.
actual_capabilities: Review DigitalOcean and Vercel deployment health signals.
Retrieve and summarize recent crash or restart logs.
Compare local and hosted environment variable names for mismatches.
Check build readiness, TypeScript errors, missing dependencies, and route compilation.
Validate API, authentication, database, and external service health.
Prepare a human-readable audit summary and issue registry entries.
limitations: Requires authenticated access to the relevant DigitalOcean and Vercel accounts.
Does not include automation scripts or provider-specific MCP configuration.
Can expose secrets if environment values are not redacted.
Is tailored to Synthex and Unite-Hub deployment conventions.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Production Restarts
use_cases.description: Review recent deployment logs, crash patterns, and runtime health before choosing a fix.

use_cases.title: Verify Release Readiness
use_cases.description: Run build checks and validate key routes before promoting a deployment.

use_cases.title: Track Deployment Risk
use_cases.description: Create concise audit summaries and issue records for follow-up planning.

prompt_templates.title: Check Deployment Health
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of current platform status.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review deployment health for the current project. Summarize availability, recent errors, and immediate risks.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Environment Settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare local and hosted environment variable names for mismatches. Do not reveal secret values; report only names and status.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Build Failure
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate troubleshooting after a failed deploy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to diagnose the latest build failure. Check build output, missing dependencies, TypeScript errors, and route compilation.

prompt_templates.title: Perform Readiness Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a full deployment readiness audit. Review logs, environment consistency, build health, runtime validation, and API health. Create a prioritized action list.

output_examples.input: Check why the deployment keeps restarting.
output: Deployment health summary: the service restarts during startup after a required setting is missing.
Recommended action: verify hosted settings, redeploy, and monitor restart logs for the next release.
Environment review: two required variable names are missing from the hosted deployment settings.
No secret values are included. Review provider settings and update the missing names before launch.
Readiness status: build checks pass, but API health needs follow-up.
Priority issue: database connectivity is unstable during runtime validation.

best_practices: Get explicit approval before reading environment files or provider settings.
Redact secret values, tokens, personal data, and internal hostnames from all reports.
Separate read-only checks from commands that install packages or change deployment state.
anti_patterns: Do not paste raw environment values into audit summaries.
Do not install dependencies without reviewing package source, version, and purpose.
Do not run cloud commands against an account unless the user confirms the target project.

faq.question: What platforms does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets DigitalOcean and Vercel deployments for projects that follow Synthex or Unite-Hub conventions.

faq.question: Does it fix deployment issues automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides diagnosis and recommends fixes, but changes should require user approval.

faq.question: Can it read secret values?
faq.answer: It can lead an agent toward secret-bearing settings. Users should require redaction and report only variable names.

faq.question: Does it require provider access?
faq.answer: Yes. Log retrieval and hosted setting checks require authenticated provider access.

faq.question: What reports can it produce?
faq.answer: It can produce a deployment health summary and issue entries for audit tracking.

faq.question: Is it useful outside Synthex or Unite-Hub?
faq.answer: Partly. The workflow is reusable, but names and expected settings are project-specific.
